meta.title: Nexo Design — AI-driven electronics design
meta.description: Nexo Design combines electronics engineering and artificial intelligence to design, simulate and validate hardware faster: PCB, firmware and embedded systems.

hero.description: We combine decades of hardware engineering with artificial intelligence models to design, simulate and validate electronic systems in a fraction of the time.

mission.title: Hardware moves at the speed of its iterations. We multiply them.
mission.p1: Every board respin costs weeks. We train models on real engineering data so that critical decisions — topology, components, thermal design — are made before the first prototype is built.
mission.p2: We don’t replace the engineer: we give them a copilot able to evaluate thousands of alternatives while they focus on what no machine can solve — the intent of the product.

platform.title: One continuous design flow, from idea to fabrication panel.

steps.title: Your schematics, our model
steps.body: We import schematics, netlists and requirements and turn them into a trainable representation of the system.

steps.title: Thousands of variants in parallel
steps.body: Generative agents explore the design space searching for the balance between cost, power and performance.

steps.title: Physics, not guesses
steps.body: Every candidate goes through accelerated solvers and real manufacturing rules before it reaches your desk.

capabilities.title: The whole electronics lifecycle under one roof.

items.title: AI-assisted PCB design
items.body: Routing, placement and layer optimization guided by models trained on thousands of production-validated boards.

items.title: Electromagnetic simulation
items.body: Surrogate models that predict signal integrity, EMC and thermals in seconds instead of hours of compute.

items.title: Firmware and embedded systems
items.body: Low-level firmware, RTOS and edge AI development on the latest MCUs, FPGAs and SoCs.

items.title: Validation and automated test
items.body: Instrumented test benches and machine-learning anomaly detection before manufacturing.

items.title: Industrialization
items.body: From prototype to series: DFM, component selection and support with European manufacturers.

items.title: Digital twins
items.body: Virtual replicas of the hardware to explore design variants and anticipate behavior in the field.

cta.title: Do you have an electronic product to design?
cta.description: Tell us the technical challenge and we’ll reply with an architecture proposal in under 48 hours.

meta.title: Products and packages — Nexo Design
meta.description: Get the AI electronics design platform, a turnkey engineering team, or the EU/UK regulatory analysis for your product.

hero.description: Subscribe to the platform and design yourself, hand the whole project to our team, or solve only the regulatory side. Packages can be combined.

packages.name: Platform
packages.body: Full access to the AI-assisted design environment: topology exploration, optimized routing, accelerated simulation and DFM validation. For teams that already have engineering and want to multiply their iterations.
features: Cloud environment with dedicated simulation compute
PCB design copilot and component selection
Signal integrity, EMC and thermal simulation
Unlimited users per project and version control

packages.name: Turnkey projects
packages.body: If you don’t have a design team behind you, we take over the full development: architecture, schematics, PCB, firmware, validation and industrialization with European manufacturers.

packages.name: EU / UK compliance
packages.body: Research and analysis of the regulatory requirements that apply to your design in the European Union and the United Kingdom. You get the map of directives, harmonized standards and required tests before certifying.
features: Identification of directives and markings (CE / UKCA)
Applicable harmonized standards (EMC, LVD, RED, RoHS)
Design requirements translated into board rules

addons.title: Add capabilities on top of any package.

items.title: Design audit
items.body: Review of an existing design with a risk report and prioritized improvements.

items.title: Digital twin
items.body: Virtual replica of the hardware to explore variants and anticipate behavior in the field.

items.title: Training
items.body: Onboarding of your team into Nexo’s AI-assisted design flow.

items.title: Priority support
items.body: Direct channel with engineering and a response SLA under 4 hours.
